documented_impact: Conflict-displaced people and refugees face flood risk and possible repeat displacement.
fcv_mediator: Displacement, service shortages and social or legal barriers constrain safe settlement and livelihood options.
possible_consequence: Constrained options can deepen flood vulnerability; this is a reported mechanism, not a measured local climate-conflict effect.
alternative_explanations: Poverty, land availability, urban planning and flood protection also shape exposure.
uncertainty: April 2023 source assertion at national floodplain scale; no named-site causal estimate or specific adaptation-project obstruction. Displacement is vulnerability, not a threat attributed to refugees.
resilience_factors: Safer settlement, inclusive services and livelihood access are operational implications to assess, not evaluated outcomes.
compact_statement: Chad's April 2023 update reports displacement into floodplains and constrained services and livelihoods, increasing flood vulnerability; local applicability remains unverified.
